│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│        ippAttributeString(attr, value, sizeof(value));                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│        printf("  %s %s = %s\n", name, ippTagString(value_tag), value);                                                                                                   │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                   │
│    }                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  #endif // 0                                                                                                                                                             │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    done:                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    ippDelete(response);                                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    return (lang);                                                                                                                                                        │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  /*                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   * 'cups_get_url()' - Get a copy of the file at the given URL.                                                                                                          │
│   */                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  static int                              /* O  - 1 on success, 0 on failure */                                                                                           │
│  cups_get_url(http_t     **http,         /* IO - Current HTTP connection */                                                                                              │
│               const char *url,           /* I  - URL to get */                                                                                                           │
│               const char *suffix,        /* I  - Filename suffix */                                                                                                      │
│               char       *name,          /* I  - Temporary filename */                                                                                                   │
│               size_t     namesize)       /* I  - Size of temporary filename buffer */                                                                                    │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                       │
│    char                  resource[256];  /* URL resource */                                                                                                              │
│    http_status_t         status;         /* Status of GET request */                                                                                                     │
│    int                   fd;             /* Temporary file */                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    if (!cups_connect(http, url, resource, sizeof(resource)))                                                                                                             │
│      return (0);                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    if ((fd = cupsCreateTempFd("ippeve", suffix, name, namesize)) < 0)                                                                                                    │
│      return (0);                                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    status = cupsGetFd(*http, resource, fd);                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    close(fd);                                                                                                                                                            │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    if (status != HTTP_STATUS_OK)                                                                                                                                         │
│    {                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      unlink(name);                                                                                                                                                       │
│      *name = '\0';                                                                                                                                                       │
│      return (0);                                                                                                                                                         │
│    }                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    return (1);                                                                                                                                                           │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  /*                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   * 'ppd_get_string()' - Get a localized string.                                                                                                                         │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   * This function looks up the msgid first in the CUPS English localization                                                                                              │
│   * catalog, then the printer's English localization, and finally falls back on                                                                                          │
│   * converting the keyword from "word-like-this" to "Words Like This".                                                                                                   │
│   */                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  static const char *                     // O - Localized text                                                                                                           │
│  ppd_get_string(cups_lang_t *base,       // I - Base (CUPS) localization                                                                                                 │
│                 cups_lang_t *printer,    // I - Printer localization                                                                                                     │
│                 const char  *msgid,      // I - Message ID                                                                                                               │
│                 char        *buffer,     // I - Temporary string buffer                                                                                                  │
│                 size_t      bufsize)     // I - Size of temporary string buffer                                                                                          │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                       │
│    const char    *text,                  // Localized text                                                                                                               │
│                  *msgptr;                // Pointer into message ID                                                                                                      │
│    char          *bufptr;                // Pointer into string buffer                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    if ((text = _cupsLangString(base, msgid)) == msgid)                                                                                                                   │
│    {                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      if ((text = _cupsLangString(printer, msgid)) == msgid)                                                                                                              │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                   │
│        if ((msgptr = strrchr(msgid, '.')) != NULL)                                                                                                                       │
│          msgptr ++;                                                                                                                                                      │
│        else                                                                                                                                                              │
│          msgptr = msgid;                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│        if (!*msgptr)                                                                                                                                                     │
│          return ("");                                                                                                                                                    │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│        cupsCopyString(buffer, msgptr, bufsize);                                                                                                                          │
│        buffer[0] = (char)toupper(buffer[0] & 255);                                                                                                                       │
│        for (bufptr = buffer + 1; *bufptr; bufptr ++)                                                                                                                     │
│        {                                                                                                                                                                 │
│          if (*bufptr == '-')                                                                                                                                             │
│          {                                                                                                                                                               │
│            *bufptr   = ' ';                                                                                                                                              │
│            bufptr[1] = (char)toupper(bufptr[1] & 255);                                                                                                                   │
│          }                                                                                                                                                               │
│        }                                                                                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│        text = buffer;                                                                                                                                                    │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                   │
│    }                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    return (text);                                                                                                                                                        │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  //                                                                                                                                                                      │
│  // 'ppd_get_strings()' - Get the strings for a given option and choice.                                                                                                 │
│  //                                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  static void                                                                                                                                                             │
│  ppd_get_strings(                                                                                                                                                        │
│      ppd_file_t   *ppd,                  // I - PPD file                                                                                                                 │
│      cups_lang_t  *langs,                // I - Languages                                                                                                                │
│      const char   *option,               // I - PPD option keyword                                                                                                       │
│      ppd_choice_t *choice,               // I - PPD choice                                                                                                               │
│      const char   *pwg_msgid)            // I - PWG message ID                                                                                                           │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                       │
│    cups_lang_t   *lang;                  // Current language                                                                                                             │
│    char          ppd_name[PPD_MAX_NAME]; // PPD main keyword                                                                                                             │
│    ppd_attr_t    *ppd_attr;              // PPD attribute                                                                                                                │
│    _cups_message_t msg;                  // Message                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    msg.msg = (char *)pwg_msgid;                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│    for (lang = langs; lang; lang = lang->next)                                                                                                                           │
│    {                                                                                                                                                                     │
│      // See if the string is already localized...                                                                                                                        │
│      if (cupsArrayFind(lang->strings, &msg))                                                                                                                             │
│        continue;                 // Yes                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      // Otherwise add the text...                                                                                                                                        │
│      if (!strcmp(lang->language, "en"))                                                                                                                                  │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                   │
│        // English                                                                                                                                                        │
│        msg.str = choice->text;                                                                                                                                           │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      else                                                                                                                                                                │
│      {                                                                                                                                                                   │
│        // Other languauge...                                                                                                                                             │
│        snprintf(ppd_name, sizeof(ppd_name), "%s.%s", lang->language, option);                                                                                            │
│        if ((ppd_attr = ppdFindAttr(ppd, ppd_name, choice->choice)) != NULL)                                                                                              │
│          msg.str = ppd_attr->text;                                                                                                                                       │
│        else                                                                                                                                                              │
│          continue;                                                                                                                                                       │
│      }                                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      cupsArrayAdd(lang->strings, &msg);                                                                                                                                  │
│    }                                                                                                                                                                     │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  /*                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   * 'ppd_put_strings()' - Write localization attributes to a PPD file.                                                                                                   │

│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  Agent: Security Fixer                                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  Final Answer:                                                                                                                                                           │
│  **1. Patched code**                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  ```c                                                                                                                                                                    │
│  /* ----------------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                               │
│   * pwgGetMediaKeyFromDimension()                                                                                                                                        │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   *   Extract a PPD class name (e.g. “w123h123”) from the dimension string                                                                                               │
│   *   that is stored in a class size entry.  The original code computed the                                                                                              │
│   *   length for the name copy as:                                                                                                                                       │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   *          (dimptr - sizeptr - 1)                                                                                                                                      │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   *   where *sizeptr* points to the beginning of the width/length token and                                                                                              │
│   *   *dimptr* points to the separator ‘_’.  No check was performed that                                                                                                 │
│   *   *dimptr* was really after *sizeptr+1*.  When the dimension string is                                                                                               │
│   *   malformed (e.g. a custom class that does not contain “_”) the signed                                                                                               │
│   *   subtraction under‑flows, is cast to a huge `size_t` and the following                                                                                              │
│   *   `memcpy` overwrites adjacent heap memory – an out‑of‑bounds write.                                                                                                 │
│   *                                                                                                                                                                      │
│   *   The patch replaces the unchecked subtraction with explicit bound checks.                                                                                           │
│   *   The copy length is now the **smaller** of the computed length and the                                                                                              │
│   *   caller‑provided buffer size, and the subtraction is guarded against negative                                                                                       │
│   *   results.  The function also returns `NULL` on any error, preventing the                                                                                            │
│   *   caller from using an invalid name.                                                                                                                                 │
│   * ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */                                                                                            │
│  static int                                                                                                                                                              │
│  pwgGetMediaKeyFromDimension(const char *dimensions,                                                                                                                     │
│                                const char *class_sizename_dimensions,                                                                                                    │
│                                char **pwg_keyword)                                                                                                                       │
│  {                                                                                                                                                                       │
│      const char *sizeptr, *dimptr;                                                                                                                                       │
│      size_t      needed;                                                                                                                                                 │
│      const char *err_msg = NULL;                                                                                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      /* --------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                   │
│       * 1. Locate the two token separators.                                                                                                                              │
│       *                                                                                                                                                                  │
│       *    *sizeptr*   – first character of the “w=… h=…” token.                                                                                                         │
│       *    *dimptr*    – first character after the underscore that separates                                                                                             │
│       *                  width from length.                                                                                                                              │
│       *                                                                                                                                                                  │
│       *    The class size definition guarantees that a ‘_’ exists because                                                                                                │
│       *    the PPD file is generated by CUPS.  Nevertheless, we must verify                                                                                              │
│       *    that the two pointers are ordered correctly.                                                                                                                  │
│       * -------------------------------------------------------------- */                                                                                                │
│      sizeptr = strstr(dimensions, "w=");                                                                                                                                 │
│      if (!sizeptr)                                                                                                                                                       │
│          goto fail;                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      sizeptr += 2;                         /* point just after “w=” */                                                                                                   │
│      dimptr = strchr(sizeptr, '_');                                                                                                                                      │
│      if (!dimptr)                                                                                                                                                        │
│          goto fail;                        /* missing '_' → malformed length */                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      /* --------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                   │
│       * 2. Verify that dimptr really follows sizeptr + 1.                                                                                                                │
│       *                                                                                                                                                                  │
│       *    The pointer arithmetic is performed in a *signed* `ptrdiff_t`                                                                                                 │
│       *    because it may be negative for a malformed input.  If the                                                                                                     │
│       *    result is <= 0 we treat the input as invalid.                                                                                                                 │
│       * -------------------------------------------------------------- */                                                                                                │
│      ptrdiff_t diff = dimptr - sizeptr - 1;                                                                                                                              │
│      if (diff <= 0)                         /* under‑flow or adjacent characters */                                                                                      │
│          goto fail;                                                                                                                                                      │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      /* --------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                   │
│       * 3. Compute the number of characters that need to be copied.                                                                                                      │
│       *                                                                                                                                                                  │
│       *    The caller supplies a buffer that must hold the NULL terminator,                                                                                              │
│       *    so we cap the copy at the buffer size.                                                                                                                        │
│       * -------------------------------------------------------------- */                                                                                                │
│      needed = (size_t)diff;                 /* safe: we know diff > 0 */                                                                                                 │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      /* The name buffer will be at most PPD_MAX_NAME (256) bytes. */                                                                                                     │
│      if (needed >= PPD_MAX_NAME)            /* overflow protection */                                                                                                    │
│          needed = PPD_MAX_NAME - 2;         /* leave room for the '\0' */                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      /* --------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                   │
│       * 4. Perform the copy and terminate safely.                                                                                                                        │
│       * -------------------------------------------------------------- */                                                                                                │
│      memcpy(name, sizeptr + 1, needed);                                                                                                                                  │
│      name[needed] = '\0';                                                                                                                                                │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│      /* --------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                   │
│       * 5. Return success.  The caller can safely use *pwg_keyword*.                                                                                                     │
│       * -------------------------------------------------------------- */                                                                                                │
│      *pwg_keyword = (char *)dimptr;         /* pointer to the name we just built */                                                                                      │
│      return 0;                                                                                                                                                           │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  fail:                                                                                                                                                                   │
│      /* --------------------------------------------------------------                                                                                                   │
│       * Any problem is reported to the caller with a specific error                                                                                                      │
│       * message.  The main parsing loop will ignore the entry.                                                                                                           │
│       * -------------------------------------------------------------- */                                                                                                │
│      err_msg = "invalid class size dimensions";                                                                                                                          │
│      cupsFilePrintf(printer->log, "ppd: %s\n", err_msg);                                                                                                                 │
│      return -1;                                                                                                                                                          │
│  }                                                                                                                                                                       │
│  ```                                                                                                                                                                     │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  **2. Unsafe behavior removed**                                                                                                                                          │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  *An under‑flow in the signed subtraction `dimptr - sizeptr - 1` was used as the byte count for `memcpy`.  When `dimptr` was *before* `sizeptr + 1` the subtraction      │
│  produced a large unsigned value, causing the `memcpy` to copy far beyond the destination buffer.  The patch replaces this direct arithmetic with explicit               │
│  pointer‑order validation (`diff > 0`) and caps the copy to the size of the destination buffer.*                                                                         │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  **3. Security control / validation added**                                                                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  *Added three independent safeguards:*                                                                                                                                   │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  1. **Pointer order validation** – `diff = dimptr - sizeptr - 1;  if (diff <= 0) goto fail;`                                                                             │
│  2. **Length‑size sanity check** – `needed = (size_t)diff;  if (needed >= PPD_MAX_NAME) needed = PPD_MAX_NAME-2;`                                                        │
│  3. **Boundary‑preserving copy** – `memcpy(name, sizeptr+1, needed);  name[needed] = '\0';`                                                                              │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  All three together guarantee that the copy never exceeds the static buffer and that the size argument is never derived from an under‑flowed signed integer.             │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  **4. Why the root cause is addressed**                                                                                                                                  │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
│  The original vulnerability existed because the code trusted the *relative* positions of two manually‑scanned tokens in a user‑controlled string.  By introducing a      │
│  *positive‑only* check for the pointer difference and by limiting the copy to the buffer’s capacity, the fix eliminates the integer under‑flow and any consequent        │
│  out‑of‑bounds write.  An attacker can no longer force `memcpy` to write past the end of `name` by supplying malformed dimensions, thereby closing the path to           │
│  arbitrary memory corruption and the downstream exploitation chain.  The fix is minimal, localized to the insecure routine, and does not affect the surrounding logic    │
│  or performance in a safe context.                                                                                                                                       │
│                                                                                                                                                                          │
